what: step 5 of the overnight plan: the gap D of the designated safety obstacle, chosen on scenes outside the campaign
scenes_note: The plan names counter_to_sink_s0, sink_to_counter_s0 and close_fridge_s4, but these are three of the 24 campaign scenes (test_scenes.json, used_for_tuning), while the step and the general rules say: non-campaign scenes only, nothing tuned on campaign scenes. They are replaced by the first screening scene of the same instruction with a scene file and runs (screening kitchens are never test kitchens): counter_to_sink_s1000, sink_to_counter_s1000, close_fridge_s1001 (close_fridge_s1000 could not be built). The extra kitchens of the two plate instructions: the first two of each in test_scenes_a8.json (sink_to_counter_s16, s17; counter_to_stove_s14, s20).
scene_build: scripts/eval_obstacle.py on the scene (start, floor obstacles, counter objects unchanged), new full-pass map, path planned again; labels by Qwen per condition (scripts/eval_decide.py)
runs: Proposed at none and at D = 0.12 first (the inputs of the rule); Nominal, and the runs at D = 0.18, only if they do not delay the campaign (they do not enter the rule)
finished: the simulator's success check; a run that crashes is retried once, a run that crashes twice counts as not finished
rule: D = 0.12 m if Proposed finishes at least as many of the 7 scenes with the obstacle at 0.12 m as with no obstacle; otherwise D = 0.18 m
a scene without an obstacle at 0.12: stays in both counts (its run at 0.12 has no obstacle)
